g.text: Step 1 of 23 · A run starts
From the CLI, the HTTP API, or a queue worker that leases queued runs.
Step 2 of 23 · Compose the application
Layered settings, model profiles and routes, plugins, hooks, instructions and skills.
Step 3 of 23 · Create the run
System prompt and hashes recorded, user_prompt hook runs, run stored as queued.
Step 4 of 23 · Step guard
Each step first checks for cancel, applies steering messages, and checks budgets.
Step 5 of 23 · pre_model hook
A hook can deny the call or add context for this request.
Step 6 of 23 · Build the context view
Bounded view of the history; older turns are summarized or omitted when it gets too long.
Step 7 of 23 · Call the model
The request is checkpointed before the provider is contacted.
Step 8 of 23 · Route to a profile
A route like fast or strong resolves to a configured model profile.
Step 9 of 23 · Provider adapter
The adapter handles the provider's quirks, headers, and health checks.
Step 10 of 23 · Model server
For example Modal running vLLM, with a bearer key and proxy headers.
Step 11 of 23 · Retries, fallback, cost
One retry budget per step; after it runs out the next fallback profile is tried. Cost is estimated.
Step 12 of 23 · Response returns
Only the final response is saved, even when tokens were streamed.
Step 13 of 23 · Did the model ask for tools?
This time it did, so the tool path runs.
Step 14 of 23 · Check permissions
pre_tool hook, then deny, mode, ask, and allow rules, then the tool's risk policy.
Step 15 of 23 · Approval if needed
Risky calls pause the run as AWAITING_INPUT until a person approves or denies.
Step 16 of 23 · Run the tool
Schema validation, timeout, idempotency key, and a file snapshot before any edit.
Step 17 of 23 · Record the result
post_tool hook runs; large outputs become artifacts; the result is checkpointed.
Step 18 of 23 · Durable checkpoint
Run and append-only events are written in one SQLite transaction, so a crash can resume here.
Step 19 of 23 · Next step
The loop starts again from the step guard.
Step 20 of 23 · Model call again
Hook, context view, and model call as before, now with the tool result in the history.
Step 21 of 23 · No tool calls
The model answered with a final message.
Step 22 of 23 · Completed
The stop hook runs and the run is marked completed.
Step 23 of 23 · Follow-ups
Continue with a new message, approve a paused run, resume after a crash, or rewind to a step.
